PDF Dual Contouring of Hermite Data - Rice University
First, we propose a new method for contouring a 3D grid of Hermite data that avoids the need to explicitly identify and process features as done in the Extended Marching Cubes method. After extending this contouring method to the case of multiple materials, we demonstrate how to model textured contours.
